name: Borys Budka - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States of the one part, and the Swiss Confederation, of the other, on the European Satellite Navigation Programmes
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should sign a cooperation agreement with Switzerland on the European satellite navigation programmes. These are the EU's satellite systems used for positioning and timing, such as Galileo. The agreement sets the terms for Switzerland to take part in these programmes. Parliament's consent is one required step before the agreement can be concluded. The report does not change the agreement's content; it approves it.

- The EU and Switzerland will cooperate on EU satellite navigation programmes.
- It affects people and businesses using satellite positioning and timing services.
- Next, the agreement can be concluded and then enter into force.
